delete.description: deleteMOI (TS 28.532): the instance and every instance it contains.

get.description: getMOIAttributes (TS 28.532): the scoped, filtered instances, hierarchical or flat, one page at a time.

patch.description: modifyMOIAttributes (TS 28.532): a merge patch or a JSON patch, by Content-Type.

put.description: createMOI (TS 28.532): creates the instance the URI names, or replaces its attributes; an `Idempotency-Key` replays the first answer.

get.description:
Liveness probe, kept as an alias of `/live`. The GUI BFF's `GET /modules/status` fans out to
`/<module>/health` through R1 Termination for every module in parallel, and DME supervises
producers on it.
Liveness probe: the process is up. Depends on nothing else.

Readiness probe: 200 when the database and SME (where this module uses them) answer, else 503
naming the failing check. Take the replica out of rotation on 503; do not restart it.

503.description: A check failed: this replica should not receive traffic

get.description: Build identity: module, release version, git SHA and build time, as set in the image (PR-OBS-8.1).
